title: Structure-Enhanced Protein Instruction Tuning: Towards General-Purpose Protein Understanding with LLMs

problem.claim: Accurate prediction of protein properties and functions is important for biological applications.

gap.claim: Fine-tuned protein models are tailored to particular downstream tasks, leaving general-purpose protein understanding as a challenge.

contributions.claim: The SEPIT framework enhances protein language models with structural knowledge and integrates them with large language models for protein understanding.

The instruction tuning pipeline warms up enhanced protein language models with contrastive learning and structure denoising, uses caption-based instructions, and applies mixture-of-experts refinement.
The authors construct a large protein instruction dataset for training and evaluating a general-purpose protein understanding model.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors explicitly describe the structure-aware module, instruction tuning pipeline, and protein instruction dataset as novel or largest and most comprehensive to date.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Extensive experiments on open-ended generation and closed-set answer tasks are reported to show superior SEPIT performance over specified closed-source and open-source language-model baselines.

narrative_sequence.summary: Protein properties and functions matter for biological applications.
Supervised fine-tuning of protein language models is presented as a promising approach.
Task-specific fine-tuning does not resolve general-purpose protein understanding.
SEPIT combines structural enhancement, staged instruction tuning, and mixture-of-experts refinement.
The authors report a protein instruction dataset and superior performance across two task categories.

source_observation.claim: The framework combines structural pretraining signals with staged instruction tuning and expert-based refinement.

interpretation.claim: General-purpose domain understanding may benefit from integrating domain structure with progressively richer instruction objectives.

application.claim: For specialized scientific models, consider combining structure-aware representations with staged alignment and task-complexity refinement.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this strategy generalizes beyond protein understanding or which component drives the reported performance.

unknowns: The abstract does not provide dataset contents, model sizes, baseline configurations, numerical results, or ablation findings.
The abstract does not specify the evaluation tasks, experimental settings, or statistical significance of the reported comparisons.
